answer.justification: In cirrhosis, HCC can be diagnosed without biopsy only with typical arterial-phase hyperenhancement plus venous/delayed washout. This 2-cm lesion enhances arterially but lacks washout, so it is not definitively HCC. Biopsy is the next step before committing to resection or ablation.
